olivia (CSM): Drafting a super short 'Launch Ops: Quick Runbook' to hand customers before going live. Needs to be copy-paste friendly. Focus: preflight, prefill, cache hygiene, batching, streaming fallback, telemetry for triage, and a simple renewal-risk box.

jaya (Field Ops): Please make prefills a one-liner CLI and include an invalidate command. Customers love runnable commands.

ryan (Solutions Eng): Also add a tiny note about client retry behavior (expo backoff + jitter, max 5 retries). And mention KV prefixing for multi-tenant.

olivia (CSM): OK layout I'm using: 1) Quick preflight, 2) Prefill example, 3) Invalidate + TTL, 4) Batching presets, 5) Streaming + fallback, 6) What to include in support ticket, 7) Renewal-risk triggers.

kai (Support): For support, ask for: request_id(s), route+model, sample prompt (redact PII), client/server timestamps, recent deploy sha. That cuts follow-ups in half.

doc-bot: template created: cs/launch-ops-quick-runbook (auto-draft)

olivia (CSM): Draft content (one-pager text):

-- Quick preflight --
- Pin route to model version.
- Capture baseline: send 50 representative requests and save median + p95 as baseline.json.

-- Prefill (one-liner) --
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/cache/prefill" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"tenant_id":"ACME-123","prompts":["welcome","summary"],"ttl_seconds":86400}'

Note: Prefill reduces cold tails but does not guarantee KV residency on every GPU.

-- Invalidate cache (quick) --
curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/cache/invalidate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant_id":"ACME-123","keys":["kv:user:42"]}'

-- Batching presets --
- Chat UI: target_batch_size=10-20, max_wait_ms=10-25
- Bulk scoring: target_batch_size=64-128, max_wait_ms=50-120
Example: `batch { target_size: 16 max_wait_ms: 20 }`

-- Streaming + fallback --
- Use `stream=true` for progressive UX. Ensure client handles partial chunks and reconnects.
- Fallback pattern: set `fallback_model: redwood-lite` when median latency > SLO or token usage spikes.

-- KV prefixing --
Use tenant-scoped prefixes to avoid cache pollution, e.g. `kv_prefix = sha256(tenant_id)[:10]`.

-- Info to include in support request --
Please attach: 1) request_id(s) 2) route + model version 3) redacted prompt samples 4) client/server timestamps 5) streaming error payloads 6) last deploy sha 7) baseline.json

-- Urgent triage copy (paste) --
"Urgent: live latency spike. Request IDs: [id1,id2]. Median latency ~2x baseline since 2026-03-20 09:30 UTC. Attached baseline.json and recent traces. Please advise fallback enablement"

-- Renewal-risk triggers (customer-facing box) --
Flag AE+SE if ANY of:
- >= 2 production incidents in 7 days
- sustained median latency >= 2x baseline for 48+ hours
- customer-reported severe UX regression (critical bugs)
Action: 15-min AE+SE sync, 24-hour mitigation plan, daily pulses until resolved.

ryan (Solutions Eng): Add for tech appendix: ensure clients honor `Retry-After` and cap retries at 5 with expo backoff + jitter.

jaya (Field Ops): I9ll produce a one-page PDF and a 2-line email snippet. Can we finalize wording by EOD?

olivia (CSM): Yes. I'll tidy copy, export PDF, and drop the email snippet in onboarding assets. Thanks team! :white_check_mark:
